structure.layout: single-page app: top nav bar, full-width segmented tabs, single-column tab panel with action buttons and a long stacked list of script rows

aesthetics.typography: Ubuntu Sans Mono for nav, buttons, list rows and body; Roboto Mono bold for the 'ToothPaste' wordmark (36px) and section headings (20px). Entirely monospace.
aesthetics.typeScale: 36px/700 wordmark, 20px/700 section heading, 16px nav, 14px/500 row titles and buttons, 12px muted meta; low contrast range apart from wordmark

notes: Terminal/hacker aesthetic: pure black background with a faint graph-paper grid SVG behind everything, all-monospace type, small 4-6px radii. Active nav item 'Paste' marked by a 1px white outline; 'Connect to Device' is a large red-outlined (#dd4058) button with a no-signal icon and hidden 'Hold to Rename' secondary label (press-and-hold interaction). New Script / Import buttons split the width 50/50 in saturated green and orange. Script rows show '• ✓ Valid •' or a red ❌ emoji for errors. Clicking a row swaps in an Edit Script view with a plain textarea, line/command/time stats footer, icon buttons (Update, delete, export, back) and a large 'Execute Script' bar.
